item.title: 'Extremely dangerous' squalls could hit some states. Here's what to do if you're stuck in one
item.description: Snow squalls are an intense burst of snowfall and gusty winds that can pop up without much warning. They usually move in and out of an area in less than an hour, according to the National Weather Service, but can be life-threatening if you're caught in one.
